moteur.contrat.frequence_positive: "{reglage}": a frequency must be strictly positive ({valeur} Hz is invalid).
moteur.contrat.hors_bande: "{reglage}": {valeurs} Hz outside the passband ({bas}-{haut} Hz). The filter removes this signal before decoding.
moteur.contrat.hors_bande_reglee: "{reglage}": {valeurs} Hz outside the passband ({bas}-{haut} Hz, set by "{reglage_bas}" and "{reglage_haut}"). The filter removes this signal before decoding. Widen the band, or change the frequency.
moteur.contrat.liste_attendue: "{reglage}": a list of numbers was expected (got: {valeur})
moteur.contrat.nombre_elements: "{reglage}": it needs between {mini} and {maxi} items, and there are {n}.
moteur.contrat.pas_diviseur: "{reglage}": {valeur} Hz is not a whole divisor of {refresh} Hz. The screen would skip frames and nothing would be detected. The closest frequencies are {proches} Hz.
moteur.contrat.refresh_positif: "{reglage}": the refresh rate must be strictly positive ({valeur} Hz is invalid).
moteur.contrat.sans_modele: No trained model: in the console, click "Train" on the mode page.
moteur.contrat.textes_attendus: "{reglage}": a list of texts was expected (got: {valeur})
moteur.contrat.trop_proches: "{reglage}": targets too close ({paires}). With a {fenetre} s window, they must be at least {ecart} Hz apart.
moteur.contrat.votes_inatteignables: "{reglage}": {votes} votes required for only {fenetres} voting windows. This can never be reached: the mode would never decide anything.
moteur.contrat.votes_partenaire: "{reglage}": the constraint "votes_atteignables" needs "{champ}", which has no value in this mode.
moteur.erreur_interne: Internal error ({type}): {detail}. Your session is not the cause: please report this error.
moteur.liaison.seance_annulee: The connection to the headset was lost during the session: the data has a gap, so the session is cancelled. Redo it once the headset is back.
moteur.proposer.hors_plage: outside the comfortable range ({lo}-{hi} Hz): {hors}. Flicker is more uncomfortable and the brain response is noisier.
moteur.proposer.impossible: impossible: no set of {n} targets at {refresh} Hz in the {bas}-{haut} Hz band.
moteur.proposer.impossible_max: impossible: at most {k} targets at {refresh} Hz in the {bas}-{haut} Hz band, with alpha at {alpha} Hz. You need a faster screen, or a wider band.
moteur.proposer.impossible_max_physiques: impossible: at most {k} targets in the {bas}-{haut} Hz band, with alpha at {alpha} Hz. Widen the band, or take fewer targets.
moteur.proposer.impossible_physiques: impossible: no set of {n} targets in the {bas}-{haut} Hz band.
moteur.refus.aucun_enregistrement: no recording in progress: nothing to stop.
moteur.refus.aucune_calibration: no training in progress: nothing to abort.
moteur.refus.aucune_mesure: no test in progress: nothing to abort.
moteur.refus.calibration_deja: A training session is already running ({mode}): abort it before starting another one.
moteur.refus.calibration_en_cours: Training for "{mode}" is running. There is only one headset, so only one activity at a time: wait for the training to end, or abort it.
moteur.refus.calibration_pas_livree: Training for "{mode}" is not available yet: the engine cannot run it yet.
moteur.refus.calibration_pendant_mode: "{mode}" is decoding right now: stop it before training it. The mode and its training would read the same marker stream: each would see only part of it, and the results would be wrong with no error.
moteur.refus.deja_demarre: "{mode}" is already started: stop it first to restart it.
moteur.refus.enregistrement_deja: a recording is already running ({chemin}): stop it before opening another one.
moteur.refus.enregistrement_mode_arrete: "{mode}" is not started: nothing to record. Start it from the grid, then come back.
moteur.refus.flux_inconnu: Unknown stream: {flux} (streams that can be published: {liste}).
moteur.refus.mesure_en_cours: "{mesure}" is running. There is only one headset, so only one activity at a time: wait for the test to end, or abort it.
moteur.refus.mesure_pas_livree: The test "{mesure}" is not available yet: the engine cannot run it yet.
moteur.refus.mesure_pendant_mode: "{mode}" is decoding right now: stop it before testing it. The mode and its test would read the same marker stream, and the score would be wrong.
moteur.refus.mesure_pendant_mode_flux: "{mode}" is decoding right now: stop it before testing it. The test publishes its decisions on the same stream as the mode, and your app would receive both mixed together.
moteur.refus.mode_inconnu_calibration: unknown mode: {id} (modes that can be trained: {liste}).
moteur.refus.mode_pendant_calibration: Training for "{mode}" is running: wait for it to end, or abort it, before starting the mode. Both would read the same marker stream.
moteur.refus.mode_pendant_mesure: The test of "{mode}" is running: wait for it to end, or abort it, before starting the mode. Both would read the same marker stream.
moteur.refus.mode_pendant_mesure_flux: The test of "{mode}" is running: wait for it to end, or abort it, before starting the mode. Both would publish on the same stream, and your app would receive their decisions mixed together.
moteur.refus.ne_propose_rien: "{reglage}" does not suggest any setting for "{mode}" (affected modes: {liste}).
moteur.refus.pas_dans_le_moteur: "{mode}" does not run in the engine: {raison}
moteur.refus.reglage_pendant_test: "{test}" is running: the settings of "{mode}" stay as they are until the test ends, since it runs on the settings it received at the start.
moteur.refus.rien_a_enregistrer: nothing to record: no training is waiting for your decision.
moteur.refus.rien_a_jeter: nothing to discard: no training is waiting for your decision.
moteur.refus.sans_calibration: "{mode}" learns nothing: there is nothing to train.
moteur.refus.secteur_inconnu: Unknown mains frequency: "{valeur}". Choose {liste} Hz: 50 in Europe, 60 in the Americas.
